subject: Request for the sha256sum od amber20

messages.author: Hector Martinez-Seara
messages.body:
Hi all,
I am one of the maintainers of the amber module on spack. Unfortunately, I
do not yet have access to amber20 on my site. Still, I would like to update
the installation recipe to allow amber20 integrated installation in spack.
As I assume that the old installation methods still exist in amber20,
despite the new CMake alternative, the only thing I need is the sah256sum
of the Amber20.tar.bz2 file. The file that people download after paying the
correspondent fee.
I would appreciate the help of anybody who has access to the new amber (not
ambertools) to provide the output of `sha256sum Amber20.tar.bz2`. *Please
note that I am NOT requesting the file itself.*
Kind regards,
Hector
